# Writing the Constitution

<!-- STEP id="assembly-1946" -->
## 1946: The Assembly Forms

Before India attained independence in 1947, the **Constituent Assembly** was formed in 1946 to draft a constitution for the country.

<!-- STEP id="the-clock" -->
## 2 Years, 11 Months, 18 Days

That is how long the Assembly took to draft the world's longest written Constitution. Dr B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of its Drafting Committee.

<!-- STEP id="two-sources" -->
## Two Sources

The Assembly's debates drew on India's own democratic traditions, and also on the spread of democratic values across the world.

**The Constitution brought old Indian traditions and global democratic values together.**
